NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 7 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 25, 3:16 PM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs is the top-projected running back on the Week 7 DraftKings main slate at 30.8 DraftKings points for $9,800, against Green Bay. Bijan Robinson (27.3, $8,500) and Christian McCaffrey (23.3, $7,600) are next.

Bijan Robinson returns the most per dollar among running backs projected for at least 9 points: 3.21 projected points per $1,000 at $8,500.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 25, 3:16 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 7

Jahmyr Gibbs, DET vs GB ($9,800)

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 30.8 DraftKings points at $9,800, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 3.5 points clear of Bijan Robinson. The model gives him 22.6 carries and 5.6 targets. The salary works out to 3.14 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs averaged 30.8 points with a simulated floor of 18.1 and a ceiling of 47.9, and he holds 36% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3.5-point favorite at home against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 29.5 in a game totaled at 55.5.

Bijan Robinson, ATL vs SF ($8,500)

Bijan Robinson projects 2nd at the position with 27.3 DraftKings points at $8,500, 2nd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 21.4 carries and 5.2 targets. The salary works out to 3.21 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 27.4 points with a simulated floor of 15.0 and a ceiling of 45.1, and he holds 26% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 2.5-point underdog at home against San Francisco, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 49.5.

Christian McCaffrey, SF at ATL ($7,600)

Christian McCaffrey projects 3rd at the position with 23.3 DraftKings points at $7,600, 3rd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 14.9 carries and 7.0 targets. The salary works out to 3.07 projected points per $1,000, 5th of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations McCaffrey averaged 23.4 points with a simulated floor of 11.3 and a ceiling of 40.9, and he holds 32% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 2.5-point favorite on the road against Atlanta, with an implied team total of 26 in a game totaled at 49.5.

Value: Woody Marks, HOU vs NYG ($5,600)

Woody Marks projects for 17.4 DraftKings points at $5,600, which works out to 3.10 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 21 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 22.2 carries and 2.4 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Marks averaged 17.4 points with a simulated floor of 7.6 and a ceiling of 32.6, and he holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Houston is a 10-point favorite at home against the Giants, with an implied team total of 26.25 in a game totaled at 42.5.
